description:
Implement a unified `run_benchmark()` interface across SQL and DataFrame adapters,
eliminating the design defect identified in code review where DataFrame adapters
lack the same interface as SQL adapters.

The current architecture violates the Adapter pattern:

| Aspect | SQL Adapters | DataFrame Adapters |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| Has `run_benchmark()` | YES | NO |
| Entry point | `adapter.run_benchmark()` | `run_dataframe_benchmark()` function |
| Caller branching | None (polymorphic) | Required (orchestrator:287, MCP:175) |

**Design Violations:**
- Liskov Substitution Principle (adapters not interchangeable)
- Open/Closed Principle (new modes require caller changes)
- Adapter Pattern (no unified interface)

**Goal:** All adapters (SQL and DataFrame) should implement the same `run_benchmark()`
method, allowing callers to use adapters polymorphically without type-checking or
branching logic.
